description: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), stock firmware family 5.13.6. Shared fail-closed gate: measured stays empty here; device readings and stock_functions live on the model-branch profile. MACH_TYPE 4091 is a source-proven build pin, not a /proc reading. Not installable.
machine_why: TARGET_MACHINE / transition r1. Proven offline from the matching stock Image machine_desc.nr and GPL mach-types / defconfig. measured.machine_id stays null.
supported_zh: Kindle Voyage（第 7 代）。共用闸门分支：measured 在此为空。MACH_TYPE 4091 是离线可证的构建钉。不能安装。
supported_en: Kindle Voyage (7th generation). Shared gate branch: measured is empty here. MACH_TYPE 4091 is a source-proven build pin. Not installable.

source.firmware_note: Official update.bin, magic SP01, cert 2, inner FB03. KindleTool extract is a format parse; download SHA-256 is not RSA verification. The matching stock Image and stock_functions hashes are recorded on the model-branch profile. This shared profile keeps measured null so the gate stays closed.
source.mach_types_note: arch/arm/tools/mach-types names mx6sl_wario as 4091. Copied into profile.machine as a build pin with stock_machine_desc_nr. Not copied into measured.machine_id.
source.stock_machine_desc_note: Matching stock Image machine_desc.nr is 4091 beside this name; imx60_wario_defconfig enables only CONFIG_MACH_MX6SL_WARIO. Details and hashes on the model-branch profile.
source.bootmode_source_note: dd_atags requires /proc/bootmode == main. An empty device reading is a real ATAG-construction risk. tools/voyage-probe-bootmode.sh re-reads only that field.
source.phys_offset_note: arch/arm/plat-mxc/include/mach/memory.h defines MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET as 0x80000000 and, under CONFIG_ARCH_MX6, selects MX6_PHYS_OFFSET 0x10000000. board-mx6sl_wario.c (pristine sha256 1091ae64f576d26e51d30949d30a04f53c2e51783b69d167229cce2759d5c563) uses MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET for boot_params. The handoff does not adopt either address.
source.patches_note: On 2026-11-12 every patch under patches/*.patch and patches/android-core/*.patch applied with tools/apply-patch-series.py onto a fresh tree of this member. That is a source result, not a boot.
